relationships.note: Trainwiz explicitly states that Aethernautics and Wheels of Lull take place in the same canon.

relationships.from: Earlier Skyrim quest mods in published ChronoC0da sequence

source_witnesses.role: current Wheels sequel/convergence and ChronoC0da sequence

modeling_policy: Keep each mod as a separate continuity/source package.
Represent lineage with explicit relationships rather than raw-record merging.
Do not use current project chronology as proof of prior exact-text publication.
Do not promote Trainwiz continuity material into Bethesda canon.
